sanskrit_verse:
आगमेनोपभोगेन नष्टं भाव्यम् अतोऽन्यथा ।
पञ्चबन्धो दमस् तस्य राज्ञे तेनाविभाविते ॥१७१॥
transliteration: āgamena upabhogena naṣṭaṃ bhāvyam ato'nyathā | pañcabandho damas tasya rājñe tenāvibhāvite ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is lost due to unauthorized enjoyment or consumption, without lawful acquisition, shall be compensated fivefold; such discipline is for the king himself when he fails in discernment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests on lawful acquisition and conscious stewardship
Causation arises from unregulated indulgence leading to depletion
Capacity-based responsibility extends even to sovereigns
Restoration logic demands proportional restitution beyond loss
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of causal error
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset depletion occurs WITHOUT prior authorized acquisition THEN compensation = 5 × value of depletion
IF ruling authority engages in unauthorized utilization THEN self-imposed restitution protocol activates
IF discernment failure leads to public loss THEN restoration obligation escalates geometrically
IF entity holds custodial capacity THEN misuse triggers fivefold liability axiom
supreme_court_application: When the highest executive authority misuses state assets without lawful cause, this verse mandates a fivefold restitution mechanism not as penalty but as compulsory realignment of sovereignty with dharma. The court must enforce this not as punishment but as completion of causal imbalance initiated by the ruler's failure in vibhavana (discernment).
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unauthorized usage creates anirvaha (causal overflow). Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as systemic depletion traceable to root indulgence. Responsibility aligns proportionally with access capacity. This is not punitive but restorative—the ruler completes what was distorted through unconscious action.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharmic audit to identify causal distortion points
Activate fivefold restitution cycle led by offending party voluntarily
Realign administrative oversight via pramāṇa-based decision architecture
Establish vibhavana council to prevent recurrence through consciousness elevation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored through conscious completion, not punitive suffering. The king’s accountability mirrors universal law—indulgence ungrounded in dharma multiplies consequences until alignment resumes. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
